acceptance.check: INV-AES-AUTH-BRAND-UNIT (authority at H1, severity refuse): neuromodulator units are brand-specific — {value} is not equivalent without brand
INV-AES-DOSE-QUALIFIERS (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): dose missing {missing} — brand and area required
INV-AES-REVERSIBILITY (derivation at H3, severity refuse): reversal proposed for a non-HA product — {value} is not reversible
INV-AES-DEVICE-QUALIFIER (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): device setting missing {missing} — settings are not transferable
INV-AES-HYALURONIDASE-INDICATION (qualifier at H3, severity refuse): hyaluronidase without indication (elective/occlusion) and protocol version
INV-AES-CONFLICT-REFUSE (derivation at H3, severity refuse): two sources conflict on a dose — refuse and report
INV-AES-PROVENANCE (provenance at H3, severity refuse): forbidden derivation: {value}
INV-AES-CURRENCY (currency at H3, severity refuse): protocol currency unverifiable — refuse

author: Cerebrum Team
description: Declarative aesthetic reasoning kit on the shared reasoning layer. 8 invariants declared in app/blocks/aesthetic/invariants.yaml across the kinds the portable spec defines (grounding, qualifier, unit_discipline, authority, provenance, currency, scope, derivation, band) and the five hooks (H0 pre-retrieval, H1 ranking, H2 tool-time, H3 answer-time, H4 export-time). Vocabulary in app/blocks/aesthetic/manifest.yaml. Scope refusals classify BEFORE retrieval. Fail closed: a kit that does not parse is DISABLED and refuses every statement rather than passing them through with no invariants. NO INTERVIEW HAS RUN, so every declared figure value is null and the block refuses rather than inventing one (app/blocks/aesthetic/KNOWN_GAPS.md). Measured by tests/blocks/test_reasoning_kits.py.

inputs.description: the operator question, classified at H0 BEFORE any retrieval
inputs.name: question

inputs.description: figures to gate: quantity, value, unit, origin, source_id, source_class, revision, qualifiers, claim_class, derivations, conditions, steps, bounds, asked_about, span, text
inputs.name: figures

inputs.description: state records by provider name, each {as_of: <epoch>}; an absent provider yields UNKNOWN, never a design-basis fallback
inputs.name: state

inputs.description: events that have happened, matched against the kit's staleness_triggers
inputs.name: events

inputs.description: subset of H0..H4 to run; all five by default, because a partial sweep is a silent coverage gap
inputs.name: hooks

name: aesthetic_kit

outputs.description: pass | annotated | flagged | refused, with findings, blocked_reason, hooks_run, retrieval_permitted, interview_status, unfilled_figures, unmeasured_invariants, ships and kit_disabled
outputs.name: verdict
